project.name: StatBook
project.summary: StatBook: 'LoL Esports Stats, Elo Rankings & History' (page title); navigation shows leaderboards including a GOAT leaderboard, Player Elo, Champion Elo, Player-Champion Elo, Team Elo, Region Elo and Recaps.

about.text: StatBook: 'LoL Esports Stats, Elo Rankings & History' (page title); navigation shows leaderboards including a GOAT leaderboard, Player Elo, Champion Elo, Player-Champion Elo, Team Elo, Region Elo and Recaps.
Professional League of Legends player, team and champion Elo rankings, career histories, GOAT leaderboards and tournament statistics.

tests.inputs: fact as shown: Champion Elo pages: one page per champion (173 listed in the page directory); page url: https://statbook.lol/page-directory.html
tests.actual: 173 champion pages; names identical to Data Dragon (9 names differ only by HTML entity encoding of ' and &)

tests.inputs: fact as shown: Player disambiguation 'Shaft (Marcel Zimmer)'; page url: https://statbook.lol/page-directory.html
tests.expected: Leaguepedia page 'Shaft (Marcel Zimmer)' exists (jungler, The Fox Sound/AT Gaming, 2013)

tests.inputs: fact as shown: Player disambiguation 'Radar (Kim Hang-min)'; page url: https://statbook.lol/page-directory.html
tests.expected: Kim 'Radar' Hang Min, Korean player, JAG Stealths 2013-2014

tests.inputs: fact as shown: Player disambiguation 'Peanut (Marcus Edborg)'; page url: https://statbook.lol/page-directory.html
tests.expected: Search found a Swedish 'Peanut' on EsportsEarnings with no full name; the famous Peanut is Han Wang-ho

tests.inputs: fact as shown: Claim: 'professional player, team and champion Elo rankings, career histories' - player pages for the 2011 Worlds winners (old) and 2026 stars (recent); page url: https://statbook.lol/page-directory.html
tests.expected: Fnatic 2011 roster (Shushei, Wewillfailer, xPeke, Cyanide, LaMiaZeaLoT, Mellisan) and 2026 players (Faker, Canyon, Knight, Bin)
tests.actual: All 6 Fnatic 2011 players and the 4 recent players have pages (/players/xpeke, /shushei, /mellisan, /lamiazlt, /cyanide, wewillfailer-1444d04b;

tests.inputs: fact as shown: Identity duplicates in the page directory; page url: https://statbook.lol/page-directory.html
tests.actual: 'Wewillfailer' and 'wewillfailer' have separate pages (different hash IDs); 'Knight' appears 3 times and 'Bin' twice with hash suffixes
